Full preferred upstream source, including shared TypeScript omitted from the npm archive: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/d901f02d5fdd33d7a7488bd8b9393f76a98b2eb1
The npm archive is retained in the project source distribution, not necessarily in the runtime Web/APK package.
Source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/mediabunny/-/mediabunny-1.61.4.tgz
Only encoding and container-writing code is bundled. All processing is local; no CDN or upload is used.
